table ip filter { # handle 1
	chain ufw-before-logging-input { # handle 37
		ct state new limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW AUDIT] " # handle 321
	}

	chain ufw-before-logging-output { # handle 38
		ct state new limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW AUDIT] " # handle 322
	}

	chain ufw-before-logging-forward { # handle 39
		ct state new limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW AUDIT] " # handle 323
	}

	chain ufw-before-input { # handle 40
		iifname "lo" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 247
		ct state related,established counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 249
		ct state invalid counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-logging-deny # handle 252
		ct state invalid counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 253
		ip protocol icmp icmp type destination-unreachable counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 254
		ip protocol icmp icmp type time-exceeded counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 255
		ip protocol icmp icmp type parameter-problem counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 256
		ip protocol icmp icmp type echo-request counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 257
		udp sport 67 udp dport 68 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 262
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-not-local # handle 263
		ip daddr 224.0.0.251 udp dport 5353 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 269
		ip daddr 239.255.255.250 udp dport 1900 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 270
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-user-input # handle 309
	}

	chain ufw-before-output { # handle 41
		oifname "lo" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 248
		ct state related,established counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 250
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-user-output # handle 310
	}

	chain ufw-before-forward { # handle 42
		ct state related,established counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 251
		ip protocol icmp icmp type destination-unreachable counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 258
		ip protocol icmp icmp type time-exceeded counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 259
		ip protocol icmp icmp type parameter-problem counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 260
		ip protocol icmp icmp type echo-request counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 261
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-user-forward # handle 311
	}

	chain ufw-after-input { # handle 43
		udp dport 137 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-skip-to-policy-input # handle 271
		udp dport 138 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-skip-to-policy-input # handle 272
		tcp dport 139 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-skip-to-policy-input # handle 273
		tcp dport 445 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-skip-to-policy-input # handle 274
		udp dport 67 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-skip-to-policy-input # handle 275
		udp dport 68 counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-skip-to-policy-input # handle 276
		fib daddr type broadcast counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-skip-to-policy-input # handle 277
	}

	chain ufw-after-output { # handle 44
	}

	chain ufw-after-forward { # handle 45
	}

	chain ufw-after-logging-input { # handle 46
		limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW BLOCK] " # handle 315
	}

	chain ufw-after-logging-output { # handle 47
		limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW ALLOW] " # handle 316
	}

	chain ufw-after-logging-forward { # handle 48
		limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW BLOCK] " # handle 317
	}

	chain ufw-reject-input { # handle 49
	}

	chain ufw-reject-output { # handle 50
	}

	chain ufw-reject-forward { # handle 51
	}

	chain ufw-track-input { # handle 52
	}

	chain ufw-track-output { # handle 53
		ip protocol tcp ct state new counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 236
		ip protocol udp ct state new counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 237
	}

	chain ufw-track-forward { # handle 54
	}

	chain INPUT { # handle 55
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-before-logging-input # handle 56
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-before-input # handle 57
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-after-input # handle 58
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-after-logging-input # handle 59
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-reject-input # handle 60
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-track-input # handle 61
	}

	chain OUTPUT { # handle 62
		type filter hook output priority filter; policy accept;
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-before-logging-output # handle 63
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-before-output # handle 64
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-after-output # handle 65
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-after-logging-output # handle 66
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-reject-output # handle 67
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-track-output # handle 68
	}

	chain FORWARD { # handle 69
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-before-logging-forward # handle 70
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-before-forward # handle 71
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-after-forward # handle 72
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-after-logging-forward # handle 73
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-reject-forward # handle 74
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-track-forward # handle 75
	}

	chain ufw-logging-deny { # handle 238
		ct state invalid limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW AUDIT INVALID] " # handle 318
		limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW BLOCK] " # handle 319
	}

	chain ufw-logging-allow { # handle 239
		limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW ALLOW] " # handle 320
	}

	chain ufw-skip-to-policy-input { # handle 240
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 243
	}

	chain ufw-skip-to-policy-output { # handle 241
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 244
	}

	chain ufw-skip-to-policy-forward { # handle 242
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 245
	}

	chain ufw-not-local { # handle 246
		fib daddr type local counter packets 0 bytes 0 return # handle 264
		fib daddr type multicast counter packets 0 bytes 0 return # handle 265
		fib daddr type broadcast counter packets 0 bytes 0 return # handle 266
		limit rate 3/minute burst 10 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump ufw-logging-deny # handle 267
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 268
	}

	chain ufw-user-input { # handle 278
		ip saddr 198.51.100.8 tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 reject with tcp reset # handle 286
		ip saddr 198.51.100.7 counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 287
		tcp dport 22 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 288
		tcp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 289
		udp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 290
		ip saddr 10.0.0.0/8 ip protocol tcp tcp dport 6000-6007 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 291
		iifname "eth0" counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 292
		ip daddr 192.168.1.10 iifname "eth0" tcp dport 443 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 293
		tcp dport 22  counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 294
		ip protocol tcp tcp dport { 80, 443 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 296
	}

	chain ufw-user-output { # handle 279
		ip daddr 8.8.8.8 udp dport 53 counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 295
	}

	chain ufw-user-forward { # handle 280
	}

	chain ufw-user-logging-input { # handle 281
	}

	chain ufw-user-logging-output { # handle 282
	}

	chain ufw-user-logging-forward { # handle 283
	}

	chain ufw-user-limit { # handle 284
		limit rate 3/minute burst 5 packets counter packets 0 bytes 0 log prefix "[UFW LIMIT BLOCK] " # handle 324
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 reject # handle 307
	}

	chain ufw-user-limit-accept { # handle 285
		counter packets 0 bytes 0 accept # handle 308
	}
}

table inet filter2 { # handle 3
	chain input { # handle 1
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy drop;
		iifname "lo" accept # handle 6
		tcp dport 22 accept comment "ssh" # handle 3
		ip saddr 203.0.113.0/24 tcp dport { 80, 443, 6000-6007 } counter packets 0 bytes 0 drop # handle 5
		meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport 53 accept # handle 8
		ip6 saddr 2001:db8::/32 reject with icmpv6 port-unreachable # handle 10
	}

	chain blocklist { # handle 2
	}
}
